It's built. And it's beautiful.

The AI life navigator for young people aging out of foster care — every screen designed, the app running end‑to‑end, and deployed. Here's the whole thing, screen by screen.

Liveon Vercel

A young person leaves foster care and, overnight, is expected to do everything a parent once did — alone. AfterCare is the calm, always-free guide that answers the question they're afraid to ask.

Built as a Next.js app on the target stack (Vercel + Postgres + Sanity + Resend), it degrades gracefully: with no keys set it runs as a complete interactive demo, so what you're about to see always works.

01First 30 seconds

Onboarding

A calm, human welcome — not a form. Trust is earned before a single question.

02The daily hub

Home

Personalized the moment they land — one active goal, quick help, and the questions their peers are actually asking.

03Adulting, gamified

Quests

Six guided life-skill journeys with real, specific content — a bank account with no co-signer, the Chafee grant most youth never claim.

04Real places, real numbers

Resources

A finder for help in their ZIP — and every listing does something: call, get directions, or text a caseworker.

05The hero

AI Chat

Live Claude answers that detect a crisis, respond in three parts — reassurance, next steps, real resources — and surface the Panic Button when it matters.

06In their control

Settings

The youth shapes how the AI explains things and how it meets their mood — never what they're allowed to ask.

07When it's an emergency

Panic Button

One red button, always in reach. A per-scenario plan with a real shelter, a crisis line, and a pre-written message so no one has to find the words — then a check-in six hours later.

To go fully live

Three settings stand between this and a public launch.

Everything below is already built — these just switch the live services on. The demo you just scrolled needs none of them.

  1. 1

    Point Vercel at the app

    Set Root Directory to web in the project settings. The Next.js app lives there.

  2. 2

    Add three keys

    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for live chat, RESEND_API_KEY for caseworker email, and a CRON_SECRET.

  3. 3

    Turn on accounts

    Add a DATABASE_URL (Postgres) to enable sign-in and cross-device sync. Optional for launch.
